svg.title: yak Dynamic Props
svg.desc: A ProgressBar takes its width from a prop. At build time, yak writes the rule to a CSS file and replaces the dynamic width with a CSS variable. The component works like a plain div that sets that variable in its style attribute. In the browser, a new percent only changes the variable.

g.text: yak turns the value into a CSS variable
The rule goes to a CSS file. Only the value stays dynamic.
The prop only sets a CSS variable
The CSS stays the same. Only the style attribute changes.
